singleSize.note: Read from JLCPCB's official capabilities page with WebFetch on 2026-09-28. It is not a /help/ article, so it is not marked verified.

panelSize.note: FAQ: 'panel size limit of not bigger than 250x250mm'. Minimum from the capabilities page.

quantity.note: Read from JLCPCB's official capabilities page with WebFetch on 2026-09-28. It is not a /help/ article, so it is not marked verified.

layers.note: Read from JLCPCB's official capabilities page with WebFetch on 2026-09-28. It is not a /help/ article, so it is not marked verified. JLCPCB lists 1-32 layers; Flamingo boards are 2, 4 or 6.

sides.note: Read from JLCPCB's official capabilities page with WebFetch on 2026-09-28. It is not a /help/ article, so it is not marked verified.

separations.note: 'for Standard assembly, you can panelize with mouse-bites or V-cut.' https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-panelization agrees: 'If V-cut and assembly is required, please select Standard Assembly.'

railsRequired.note: Read from JLCPCB's official capabilities page with WebFetch on 2026-09-28. It is not a /help/ article, so it is not marked verified. Edge rails and fiducials are both listed as necessary for Standard PCBA.

toolingHoleCornerOffset.note: Distance from the panel corner along the rail. JLCPCB publishes no figure.

fiducialMaskDiameter.note: Common practice is a mask opening twice the copper diameter. JLCPCB's page gives no figure.

fiducialEdgeDistance.note: Minimum from the fiducial centre to the panel edge, so the conveyor rails do not cover it.

fiducialCornerOffset.note: Distance from the panel corner along the rail; keeps the fiducial clear of the tooling hole.

width.note: Derived: 5 holes of 0.6 mm at 1.0 mm pitch span 4.6 mm. The page gives hole counts, not a tab width. Blog post, not a /help/ article.

pitch.note: 'add a set of mouse bites every 50-60 mm'. Blog post, not a /help/ article.

maxLength.note: Longest gap a tab is allowed to bridge.

holePitch.note: 0.6 mm holes with 0.35-0.4 mm edge-to-edge spacing (minimum 0.3 mm). Blog post, not a /help/ article.

holeOverlap.note: 'in the centerline of the board frame or extending one-third into the board'. Blog post, not a /help/ article.

minPerInstance.note: 'At least 2 symmetrically placed sets are needed'. Blog post, not a /help/ article.

copperClearance.note: Warn when a mouse-bite hole comes closer than this to copper or a drill on the board.

overhangMargin.note: Clearance kept beyond the tip of a part that overhangs the board edge.

keepoutClearance.note: Clearance kept from an edge that carries a keepout (for example an antenna region).

keepoutEdgeTolerance.note: A keepout counts as a board-edge keepout when it comes within this distance of the edge.

maxDesigns.note: 'The number of the designs shall not exceed 10 designs on one board'.

freeDesigns.note: A search-result summary of this page says more than 5 designs are still charged as different designs. The page text fetched on 2026-09-28 did not contain that sentence, so this is unverified.

lineWidth.note: Minimum silkscreen line width on every JLCPCB tier (engine RULESETS.minSilkWidth).

minFillRatio.note: A board qualifies for the silkscreen-divider approach when its outline fills at least this fraction of its bounding box, i.e. it can be cut out with straight cuts.

straightEdgeToEdge.note: 'The V-cut line can only be a vertical or horizontal straight line.' 'The V-cut line must cross the whole panel or else the factory can't add a V-groove on the PCB'; they 'cannot stop part way across the panel'. Boards sit with 'zero space between the sub-boards'.

minPanelSize.note: 'The panel size needs to be 70*70mm at least to do v-cut process.' https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-dimensions says the same. Applies to the whole panel, rails included; JLCPCB states no V-cut-specific minimum for one board on it.

maxPanelSize.note: 'If there are both horizontal and vertical V-cuts, the maximum panel size is 475*475mm.' https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-dimensions gives 475 x 475 mm as the V-cut panel maximum without that condition, so Flamingo applies it to every V-cut panel.

minLineSpacing.note: 'Minimum clearance between two parallel V-cut lines is 2mm.' The capabilities page recommends 3 mm.

maxLinesPerAxis.note: 'please ensure that there are no more than 25 V-cut lines on either the X or Y side.'

smallBoardSide.note: 'If either side of the small piece is within 15mm, there will be extra cost for V-cut process.' The amount is not in the text of https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/in-what-cases-will-there-be-charged-extra (it is only in an image), so the fee table has no figure for it.

copperClearance.note: Read from JLCPCB's capabilities page with WebFetch on 2026-10-26: 'Copper clearance from V-cut board edges: >= 0.4 mm'. It is not a /help/ article, so it is not marked verified. JLCPCB's V-cut blog post recommends 1.0 mm.

minThickness.note: Capabilities page, read 2026-10-26: 'PCB thickness >= 0.6 mm'. The help article https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-panelization only says 'V-cut is not available on 0.4mm PCB thickness.' Not checked: Flamingo boards carry no thickness.

layers.note: Neither the help article nor the capabilities page (read 2026-10-26) limits V-cut by layer count, so every layer count Flamingo makes is allowed. Unverified: the absence of a limit is not a stated rule.

allowNoRails.note: The help article does not require rails on a V-cut panel; it says fiducials and tooling holes are 'added to the Edge Rails by default' when JLCPCB panelizes. Standard PCBA still asks for rails (assembly.standard.railsRequired). Unverified: no sentence allows or forbids a rail-less V-cut panel.

gerberLayer.note: The outline layer is 'boardname.GKO/GM1' for 'Board Outline (slots, v-cut lines and so on)'. https://jlcpcb.com/help/article/pcb-panelization: 'make sure that the V-cut lines, cutouts, millings and slots are in the same layer with the board outline.'

label.note: 'For board areas that need to be V-cut, please mark "V-CUT" on the same layer as the board outline.' Blog post, not a /help/ article; no help article read on 2026-10-26 mentions a label. Flamingo puts the label outside the panel edge, past the end of each line, so it never lands on material.

lineWidth.note: Stroke width of a score line on the profile layer, the same as the profile outline's.

labelHeight.note: Text height of the V-CUT label on the profile layer.
